units.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. Appointed officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are municipal servants with an established range of duties to support the powers of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and responsibility for performing those duties, vested with executive and administrative powers to resolve matters of local significance of the municipality and/or organize the activities of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. Officials appointed by the Head of Yekaterinburg include the First Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg, Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg, the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, heads of district administrations and their deputies, and heads of bodies of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. Fixed-term employment contracts are concluded with all appointed officials for the term of office of the Head of Yekaterinburg in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. The procedure for appointing officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is established by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 39. Officials of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 28.01.2014 No. 1/9.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 39

units.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.label: Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 1. The Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg is a permanent body established under the Head of Yekaterinburg to conduct collective discussion and develop decisions on the municipality’s most important matters of local significance.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 2. The Head of Yekaterinburg forms the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg and directs its work.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 3. The Collegium includes, ex officio, the First Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg, Deputy Heads of Yekaterinburg, the Deputy Head of Yekaterinburg — Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg or the Chief of Staff of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg, heads of district administrations, the Director of the Finance Department and the Director of the Economy Department. Other officials may be included in the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg by executive order of the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 4. Deputies of the City Duma and representatives of public organizations, mass media and territorial public self-government may participate in meetings of the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 5. Meetings of the Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg are generally held at least once a month.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Collegium of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg
units.text: 6. The powers of the Collegium and the procedures for its work and preparation of decisions are determined by regulations approved by a legal act of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 40

units.text: Article 41. District administration
units.label: Art. 41

units.text: 1. A district administration exercises executive and administrative powers within the territory of the municipality’s district, within the competence established by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 41

units.text: 2. The activities of a district administration are directed by the head of the district administration.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 41

units.text: 3. The head of a district administration is appointed by the Head of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 41

units.text: 4. Regulations on a district administration are approved by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 41

units.text: 5. A district administration has the right to establish structural subdivisions within it. Its structure is developed by the head of the district administration on the basis of the standard structure and approved by a legal act of the Administration of the City of Yekaterinburg.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 41

units.text: 6. Expenditure on maintaining a district administration is provided for in the municipal budget.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 41

units.text: 7. A district administration has the rights of a legal entity.
units.label: Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 8. Repealed. — Decision of the Yekaterinburg City Duma of 23.10.2012 No. 42/64.
units.label: Point 8 Art. 41

units.text: Article 41-1. Chamber of Accounts
units.label: Point 8 Art. 41 · “Article 41-1. Chamber of Accounts”

units.text: 1. The Chamber of Accounts is a permanent body of external municipal financial control.
units.label: Point 1 Art. 41

units.text: 2. The Chamber of Accounts is formed by the City Duma and is accountable to it.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 41

units.text: 3. The Chamber of Accounts comprises its Chair, Deputy Chair, auditors and staff.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 41

units.text: The structure of the Chamber of Accounts is determined according to the procedure established by a normative legal act of the City Duma. Its staffing level is determined by a legal act of the City Duma on the submission of the Chair of the Chamber of Accounts, taking into account the need to exercise the powers assigned by legislation and to ensure the organizational and functional independence of the Chamber of Accounts.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 41 · “The structure of the Chamber of Accounts is determined…”

units.text: The posts of Chair, Deputy Chair and auditors of the Chamber of Accounts are municipal offices.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 41 · “The posts of Chair, Deputy Chair and auditors of the Chamber of…”

units.text: 4. The Chair, Deputy Chair and auditors of the Chamber of Accounts are appointed by the City Duma for a term of 5 years.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 41

units.text: Proposals for candidates for the post of Chair of the Chamber of Accounts are submitted to the City Duma by:
units.label: Point 4 Art. 41 · “Proposals for candidates for the post of Chair of the Chamber…”

units.text: the Head of Yekaterinburg;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 41 · “the Head of Yekaterinburg;”

units.text: the Chair of the City Duma;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 41 · “the Chair of the City Duma;”

units.text: deputies of the City Duma numbering at least one third of the established number of deputies of the City Duma.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 41 · “deputies of the City Duma numbering at least one third of the…”

units.text: Proposals for candidates for the posts of Deputy Chair and auditors of the Chamber of Accounts are submitted to the City Duma according to the procedure established by the Regulations on the Chamber of Accounts approved by the City Duma.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 41 · “Proposals for candidates for the posts of Deputy Chair and…”

units.text: 5. The Chamber of Accounts has the rights of a legal entity.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 41

units.text: 6. The organization and activities of the Chamber of Accounts are governed by the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization and Activities of Control and Accounts Bodies of the Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation and Municipalities’, the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation’, the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, other federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, the Regulations on the Chamber of Accounts approved by the City Duma, and other municipal normative legal acts. In the cases and according to the procedure established by federal laws, the organization and activities of the Chamber of Accounts are also legally regulated by laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 41

units.text: 7. The Chamber of Accounts exercises the following principal powers:
units.label: Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 1) organizing and exercising control over the legality and efficiency of the use of municipal budget funds and, in cases provided for by legislation of the Russian Federation, other funds;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 2) expert examination of draft municipal budgets, verification and analysis of the justification for their indicators;
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 3) external verification of the annual report on execution of the municipal budget;
units.label: Subpoint 3 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 4) conducting audits in the procurement of goods, works and services in accordance with Federal Law of 5 April 2013 No. 44-ФЗ ‘On the Contract System in the Procurement of Goods, Works and Services to Meet State and Municipal Needs’;
units.label: Subpoint 4 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 5) assessing the efficiency of the formation, management and disposal of municipal property and monitoring compliance with the established procedure for the formation, management and disposal of such property (including exclusive rights to the results of intellectual activity);
units.label: Subpoint 5 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 6) assessing the efficiency of granting tax and other benefits and advantages and budget loans funded from the municipal budget, as well as assessing the legality of providing municipal guarantees and sureties or securing the performance of obligations by other means for transactions entered into by legal entities and individual entrepreneurs using municipal budget funds and municipally owned property;
units.label: Subpoint 6 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 7) expert examination of draft municipal legal acts insofar as they concern the municipality’s expenditure obligations, expert examination of draft municipal legal acts that change municipal budget revenues, and of municipal programmes (draft municipal programmes);
units.label: Subpoint 7 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 8) analysis and monitoring of the budget process in the municipality, including preparation of proposals to eliminate identified deviations in the budget process and improve the budget legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint 8 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 9) conducting ongoing analysis of execution and monitoring the organization of execution of the municipal budget in the current financial year, and submitting quarterly information to the City Duma and the Head of Yekaterinburg on the progress of municipal budget execution and the results of control and expert-analytical activities carried out;
units.label: Subpoint 9 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 10) monitoring the state of municipal domestic and external debt;
units.label: Subpoint 10 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 11) assessing, within the competence of the Chamber of Accounts, the feasibility, risks and results of achieving the municipality’s socio-economic development objectives provided for in its strategic planning documents;
units.label: Subpoint 11 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 12) participating, within its powers, in measures aimed at combating corruption;
units.label: Subpoint 12 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: 13) other powers in the sphere of external municipal financial control established by federal laws, laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast, this Charter and normative legal acts of the City Duma.
units.label: Subpoint 13 Point 7 Art. 41

units.text: The Chamber of Accounts is a subject of rule-making initiative and may introduce drafts of municipal legal acts.
units.label: Subpoint 13 Point 7 Art. 41 · “The Chamber of Accounts is a subject of rule-making initiative…”

units.text: 8. External municipal financial control is exercised by the Chamber of Accounts:
units.label: Point 8 Art. 41

units.text: 1) in relation to local self-government bodies and municipal bodies, municipal institutions and unitary enterprises, and other organizations if they use municipally owned property;
units.label: Subpoint 1 Point 8 Art. 41

units.text: 2) in relation to other persons in the cases provided for by the Budget Code of the Russian Federation and other federal laws.
units.label: Subpoint 2 Point 8 Art. 41

units.text: 9. The activities of the Chamber of Accounts are financed from the municipal budget.
units.label: Point 9 Art. 41

units.text: 10. Measures for the material and social provision of the Chair, Deputy Chair, auditors, inspectors and other staff of the Chamber of Accounts are established by municipal legal acts of the municipality in accordance with the Federal Law ‘On the General Principles of the Organization and Activities of Control and Accounts Bodies of the Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation and Municipalities’, other federal laws and laws of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 41

units.text: Officials of the Chamber of Accounts are guaranteed monetary remuneration (compensation), annual paid leave (basic and additional), professional development, including additional professional education, and other material and social provision measures established for persons holding municipal offices and municipal-service posts in the municipality.
units.label: Point 10 Art. 41 · “Officials of the Chamber of Accounts are guaranteed monetary…”

units.text: Article 42. Municipal service
units.label: Art. 42

units.text: 1. Municipal service is the professional activity of citizens carried out on a permanent basis in municipal-service posts filled by concluding an employment agreement (contract).
units.label: Point 1 Art. 42

units.text: 2. Municipal-service posts are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with the register of municipal-service posts approved by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast.
units.label: Point 2 Art. 42

units.text: 3. A citizen enters municipal service through appointment to a municipal-service post under the terms of an employment contract in accordance with labour legislation, taking into account the special provisions of legislation on municipal service.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 42

units.text: 4. Qualification requirements concerning the level of professional education, length of municipal service or length of work in a speciality or field of training necessary to hold municipal-service posts are established by municipal legal acts on the basis of standard qualification requirements for municipal-service posts, which are determined by a law of Sverdlovsk Oblast in accordance with the classification of municipal-service posts, except for certain municipal-service posts whose qualification requirements are established by federal laws and/or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 42

units.text: Qualification requirements concerning the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties, as well as the speciality and field of training, are established in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Point 4 Art. 42 · “Qualification requirements concerning the knowledge and skills…”

units.text: 5. The rights and duties of municipal servants are established by the federal law on municipal service.
units.label: Point 5 Art. 42
